//: Claude Code: one entry per argocd-mcp instance. 'type':'http' is required. See docs/auth.md for how the OIDC client config depends on Dynamic Client Registration (DCR).

argocd-tools.//: OIDC via Authentik (no DCR): give the pre-registered public client_id + the provider's OIDC discovery URL. Browser login on first use; run: claude mcp login argocd-tools.

argocd-keycloak.//: OIDC via a DCR-capable provider (e.g. Keycloak): just the URL — the client self-registers.
